The company has initiated a search for a permanent successor. Mr. Rouquet will work with Ms. Myers and Visteon&#8217;s leadership team through November 30 to support a smooth transition.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Ms. Myers has served as Visteon's Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer since January 2024. She joined Visteon in 2015 and has held several finance leadership roles, including Assistant Controller and Senior Manager of Reporting and Consolidations.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#24282f;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">&#8220;On behalf of the Board and Executive Team, I would like to thank Jerome for his leadership and contributions to Visteon over the past six years,&#8221; said Sachin Lawande, President and Chief Executive Officer. &#8220;He has been a valued member of our leadership team, and we appreciate his service to the company. We wish him the very best in his future endeavors. Colleen brings extensive financial leadership experience and deep knowledge of Visteon. We are confident in her ability to lead the finance organization during this transition.&#8221;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#24282f;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">&#8220;Leaving Visteon was a difficult decision, and I am grateful to Sachin, the Board and my colleagues for their partnership over the past six years,&#8221; Rouquet said. &#8220;I remain confident in Visteon&#8217;s direction, strategy and long-term success. The company&#8217;s state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions.
